description: Calendar of statutory deadlines for businesses in Uzbekistan (tax returns and payments, financial statements, statistics, corporate and HR deadlines), each with the legal source. Without a query returns the deadlines falling in the next 45 days; with a query — matching rules with their next date. The data is in Russian.

query.description: Topic, e.g. "НДС", "налог с оборота", "годовая отчётность", "собрание участников"
